records.preparation: Prepare the two-part working solution immediately before use. Standard dilution is 1+1+100, with documented alternatives from 1+1+50 to 1+1+150. Use distilled or demineralised water where possible.
records.reuseInstructions: Moersch states that the mixed working solution should be stirred well until almost colourless and then used within the next 10-15 minutes; prepare a fresh working solution for each development batch.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Mixed working solution: use within 10-15 minutes after preparation.

records.reuseInstructions: Developer and alkali are diluted 1+1+100 with water immediately before development. The high-dilution working bath is prepared for the current processing batch; minimum combined A+B concentrate is 5 ml per film.
records.sourceTitle: Moersch Tanol product information and developing chart

records.reuseInstructions: Prepare the two-part working solution immediately before development. Moersch states that after mixing and stirring it should become almost colourless and be used within the next 10-15 minutes.
records.sourceTitle: Moersch Tanol Speed Developing Times Chart

records.preparation: Prepare the powder kit as two separate stock solutions A and B, each to 2 litres. Temper both solutions before processing. For rotary development Moersch specifies dilution of both solutions 1+1; single-bath mixing of A and B is also possible when contrast compensation is not required.
records.reuseInstructions: For small working volumes Moersch recommends using bath B only once or twice for reproducibility. With 700 ml or more working volume for one roll, the bath can be used several times without loss of performance. Undiluted B stock can also be used several times; A and B refill packs are available separately when one bath is exhausted first.
records.capacityText: Capacity is dilution- and volume-dependent rather than a single roll count. Moersch states that higher dilution increases capacity; small volumes favour one or two uses of bath B, while working volumes of 700 ml or more may be reused several times without loss of performance.
records.shelfLifeStock: The two stock solutions remain stable for at least 6 months even in partially filled bottles; with exclusion of air Moersch reports about one year based on experience.
records.storageNotes: Keep the stock solutions protected from air to maximize their life. Temper both baths to the processing temperature immediately before use.
records.sourceTitle: Moersch MZB Two-Bath Compensating Developer instructions
